scope: Walking browser release; numerical and transform verification, not empirical validation.

checks: 120 seeded poses and four world contacts
front, side, top and orbit cameras
CSV/JSON export and share link reload
invalid JSON and unstable geometry rejection
desktop/mobile no overflow or page errors

limitations: Prescribed shoulder motion; no adaptive human gait or forward travel.
Fixed-step parity does not establish pointwise convergence of recontact force spikes.
Illustrative rath mesh does not determine physical parameters.
